# browser []
  cargo test -p demo-web --profile test-release --test web --features base-feature -- selenium --nocapture
    DEMO_BROWSER=firefox
# browser [--profile ci --timings]
  cargo test -p demo-web --profile test-release --test web --features base-feature --timings -- selenium --nocapture
    DEMO_BROWSER=firefox
# browser [-E test(seek)]
  cargo test -p demo-web --profile test-release --test web --features base-feature -E test(seek) -- selenium --nocapture
    DEMO_BROWSER=firefox
# docs []
  cargo test --doc --workspace --exclude demo-web --features base-feature
# docs [--profile ci --timings]
  cargo test --doc --workspace --exclude demo-web --features base-feature --profile ci --timings
# docs [-E test(seek)]
  cargo test --doc --workspace --exclude demo-web --features base-feature -E test(seek)
# loom []
  cargo-nextest nextest run --workspace --cargo-profile test-release --features base-feature,demo/loom -E test(loom_model_)
    CARGO=<cargo>
# loom [--profile ci --timings]
  cargo-nextest nextest run --workspace --cargo-profile test-release --features base-feature,demo/loom -E test(loom_model_) --profile ci --timings
    CARGO=<cargo>
# loom [-E test(seek)]
  cargo-nextest nextest run --workspace --cargo-profile test-release --features base-feature,demo/loom -E '(test(loom_model_)) & ((test(seek)))'
    CARGO=<cargo>
# suite []
  cargo-nextest nextest run --workspace --exclude demo-tools --exclude demo-web --features base-feature,virtual-time
    CARGO=<cargo>
# suite [--profile ci --timings]
  cargo-nextest nextest run --workspace --exclude demo-tools --exclude demo-web --features base-feature,virtual-time --profile ci --timings
    CARGO=<cargo>
# suite [-E test(seek)]
  cargo-nextest nextest run --workspace --exclude demo-tools --exclude demo-web --features base-feature,virtual-time -E test(seek)
    CARGO=<cargo>
# tools []
  cargo-nextest nextest run -p demo-tools --features base-feature
    CARGO=<cargo>
# tools [--profile ci --timings]
  cargo-nextest nextest run -p demo-tools --features base-feature --profile ci --timings
    CARGO=<cargo>
# tools [-E test(seek)]
  cargo-nextest nextest run -p demo-tools --features base-feature -E test(seek)
    CARGO=<cargo>
# typed []
  cargo-nextest nextest run -p demo -p demo-tests --cargo-profile test-release --lib --test suite --features base-feature,cpu-load,demo/native-net,nb-detect,virtual-time --test-threads 1 --ignore-default-filter -E test(fast)
    CARGO=<cargo>
    DEMO_MODE=strict
# typed [--profile ci --timings]
  cargo-nextest nextest run -p demo -p demo-tests --cargo-profile test-release --lib --test suite --features base-feature,cpu-load,demo/native-net,nb-detect,virtual-time --test-threads 1 --ignore-default-filter -E test(fast) --profile ci --timings
    CARGO=<cargo>
    DEMO_MODE=strict
# typed [-E test(seek)]
  cargo-nextest nextest run -p demo -p demo-tests --cargo-profile test-release --lib --test suite --features base-feature,cpu-load,demo/native-net,nb-detect,virtual-time --test-threads 1 --ignore-default-filter -E '(test(fast)) & ((test(seek)))'
    CARGO=<cargo>
    DEMO_MODE=strict
